text: じゃあ…　おまえも　ポケモン　リーグに　いく　わけ？

structure.jp: おまえも　ポケモン　リーグに　いく　わけ？
structure.en: that means you're going to the Pokémon League too?

patterns.name: 〜わけだ
patterns.explanation: わけ after a verb says 'so that's how things are', a conclusion drawn from what you just learned. Here だ is dropped and it is asked as a question. いく　わけ？ = 'so that means you're going?'
